defeaters: Location-only binding: matching quran_loc without exact wbw location, written surface, subject, fact type, value, and reason tuple is insufficient.

Cross-fact replay: an artifact that proves a governor relation cannot certify a contextual-function, case, mood, or rendering fact unless the closed type-specific extraction equals that fact's complete binding tuple.
Shape laundering: quran:S:A:0, quran:S:A, a missing word index, a normalized surface, or an ayah-wide address cannot stand in for an exact canonical word occurrence.

Carrier laundering: a tools/validate_two_vote_artifacts.py-valid carrier, declared reviewer metadata, or matching engine strings cannot substitute for two real hash-bound qamus.two_vote_worker_record.v1 records and the external CLI model proof they name.
Partial grammatical match: matching function while governor, governed subject, attachment, case or mood value, sign, sign visibility, mood basis, or reason key differs defeats eligibility.
Free-prose substitution: matching gloss text, grammatical prose, evidence summary, or actor-supplied description cannot replace the governed conclusion and reason tuple.
Unknown mapping: a TWO_VOTE_FACT_TYPES member without a complete closed fact-type binding extractor fails closed and routes to escalation.
definition_of_done: The pre-fix same-location unrelated-fact false green is reproduced by a red-first pure unit test before implementation.

Every two-vote eligibility decision first consumes a tools/validate_two_vote_artifacts.py-valid two_vote_verified carrier, then compares a deterministic exact binding tuple, then requires a tools/validate_two_vote_worker_records.py-valid blinded pair backed by real external CLI invocation metadata. Carrier validity alone never proves independent votes.

The binding tuple covers quran and wbw word identity, exact written surface, explicit fact subject, fact type, type-specific fact value or conclusion, structured reason key, governor tuple, and case or mood tuple when applicable.
Word zero, ayah-only addresses, normalized-surface substitution, missing binding fields, and every cross-fact replay mutation fail closed with precise non-secret errors.

The governed reason key is read only from qamus/skills/reason-key-registry.jsonl, must be a current kind reason_key id, and must equal the carrier agreement key, both vote reason keys, and the candidate fact reason key; the eligibility evidence records the registry SHA-256 and fails closed on drift.

The external pair records carry private CLI path, redacted argv, fallback_model_configured false, requested and actual model, model ID, CLI version, distinct session ids, start SHAs, branches, worktrees, permitted files, the closed output-artifact-or-commit oneOf and hashes, frozen worklist and submission hashes, model-proof artifacts and hashes, access_to_other_reviewers_work false, and no_cross_access true. Missing, substituted, fallback-enabled, same-session, copied-submission, cross-access, or hash-drifted proof defeats eligibility.

The packet-specific tests are pure: they do not call register, transition a fact to certified, append an event, or write any certification store. Synthetic worker records may test rejection logic but never count as real Opus 5 or Sonnet 5 proof.
The existing candidate to review_required to certified transition and owner authorization boundary remain intact; this packet grants no certification or deployment authority.
TP-PVN-REANCHOR-HARNESS-INTEGRATION-W1 exclusively owns later tools/check_regressions.py and docs/golden-commands.md updates.

The start SHA is frozen before edits; the deterministic tracked-plus-untracked changed-path check matches exactly the two permitted repository paths, protected authority drift and git diff --check run separately, and no generated artifact drifts.

The engine dependency, focused suite, carrier validator, worker-record validator, complete unchanged regression harness, changed-path allowlist, protected-evidence drift check, and whitespace check all pass.

escalation_trigger.route: stop without certifying or rewriting any fact; record the exact missing binding field or incompatible fact type in the implementation handoff and route schema or historical-data decisions to the owner-gated certifier lane

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: If the fact lacks an explicit exact occurrence, surface, subject, value, governed reason key, governor, or case or mood field, or if either real external worker record and its CLI proof cannot be hash-verified, return a binding or independence error and preserve candidate or review-required state. Never infer equality or independence from location, gloss, normalized surface, related fact, prose summary, carrier metadata, engine name, or synthetic record.
evidence_policy.statement: Two-vote evidence licenses only the exact typed fact it reconstructibly proves. Generic artifact validation proves carrier validity only. Eligibility additionally requires exact candidate-to-carrier tuple equality, current governed reason-key registry binding, and two real independent external worker records whose CLI model proof, frozen inputs, outputs, hashes, and no-cross-access state validate.

Pure red-first unit suite covering exact positive tuples and all replay, word-zero, ayah-only, surface, subject, fact-type, value, reason, governor, and case or mood mutations

guards: TP-TWO-VOTE-ENGINE-INDEPENDENCE-W1, qamus/schemas/two-vote-worker-record.schema.json, tools/validate_two_vote_worker_records.py, and their focused tests must be integrated and green before this packet starts.

Carrier validation, exact fact binding, external worker-record validation, and certification authorization are four separate mandatory gates. tools/validate_two_vote_artifacts.py proves carrier validity only; it never proves independent reviewers, sessions, models, frozen inputs, or no-cross-access.
The exact occurrence is a word occurrence with positive surah, ayah, and word positions plus matching quran_loc, wbw_loc, and written surface; no ayah-only or word-zero widening is allowed.
The fact subject is explicit and type-specific. It must not be guessed from location, entry family, lexical root, surface resemblance, gloss, or another fact in the same occurrence.
Use a closed dispatch for every fact type in TWO_VOTE_FACT_TYPES. Missing fields, unsupported versions, unknown fact types, and ambiguous mappings fail closed.

The structured comparison includes the carrier agreement key and both votes' matching reason key, plus the canonical conclusion subset for the fact type. The same reason key must be a current kind reason_key id at qamus/skills/reason-key-registry.jsonl, and its registry SHA-256 is bound into eligibility evidence. Prose and gloss text never establish equality.

Certification eligibility requires two qamus.two_vote_worker_record.v1 rows validated with tools/validate_two_vote_worker_records.py and the real external CLI proof they hash-bind. The pair must have distinct reviewer, lane, session, output, and frozen-submission identities; exact requested and actual model proof; explicit access_to_other_reviewers_work false; and no_cross_access true.

The external worker records must satisfy the exact model IDs and no-fallback policy declared by their governing owner packet. For an Opus 5 or Sonnet 5 lane, requested_model, actual_model, and model_id must equal claude-opus-5 or claude-sonnet-5 exactly; no certifier fallback or substitution is allowed.

Governor and case or mood components are compared exactly when applicable, including locations, normalized surface only where the canonical v1.1 comparator already authorizes it, relation key or tuple, value, sign, sign visibility, and mood basis.

Packet-specific tests exercise only a pure binding predicate over in-memory or temporary candidate data. They never call register, never transition to certified, never append an event, and never write a certification store.

Start only from a clean isolated worktree. Before the first repository edit, run the packet command that freezes HEAD under out/certifier-two-vote-exact-binding-w1/start-sha.txt; never recalculate it from a later HEAD, main, merge-base, or reflog.
The start-SHA file is a gitignored local run record only. Do not commit it, and do not widen the exact two-path repository allowlist.
tools/check_regressions.py and docs/golden-commands.md are read-only in this packet. Their shared updates are reserved for the future single integration packet TP-PVN-REANCHOR-HARNESS-INTEGRATION-W1.

Only tools/certify_typed_fact.py retains certification authority. Successful binding establishes eligibility only; the existing review transition, complete evidence bundle, actor record, and explicit owner-gated apply or deploy boundary still govern certification.
No existing certification row, two-vote artifact, typed fact, schema, reason-key registry, public payload, website code, or live surface is writable.
